beams_isolates_{variant}.short_description: Monthly count of {variant.short_name} isolates reported through the BEAM Dashboard.
beams_isolates_{variant}.long_description: Monthly number of {variant.short_name} isolates from human, food, animal, and environmental sources reported to the System for Enteric Disease Response, Investigation, and Coordination (SEDRIC) and published on the CDC BEAM Dashboard. Counts are aggregated across all source types (human, food, animal, environment), source sites, and serotypes/species.

beams_outbreak_isolates_{variant}.long_name: Number of outbreak-associated {variant.short_name} isolates reported to SEDRIC
beams_outbreak_isolates_{variant}.short_description: Monthly count of {variant.short_name} isolates linked to a recognized outbreak.
beams_outbreak_isolates_{variant}.long_description: Monthly number of {variant.short_name} isolates that were linked to a recognized single-state or multistate outbreak, out of the total isolates reported to SEDRIC and published on the CDC BEAM Dashboard. A value of 0 means no outbreak-associated isolates were identified that month, which is the large majority of records.
beams_outbreak_isolates_{variant}.statement: In {location}, {value} {variant.short_name} isolates in {time} were linked to a recognized outbreak.

beams_isolates_rate_{variant}.long_description: Monthly number of {variant.short_name} isolates reported to SEDRIC and published on the CDC BEAM Dashboard, divided by 2021 Census population and scaled per 100,000 residents. Uses a single-year (2021) population denominator for all years, the same convention used elsewhere in this repository (e.g. nhtsa_crash), so it does not reflect year-to-year population change. Jurisdictions without a 2021 Census population figure in resources/census_population_2021.csv.xz (Guam, US Virgin Islands) are left as missing rather than estimated.
beams_isolates_rate_{variant}.statement: In {location}, the {variant.short_name} isolate rate was {value} per 100,000 population in {time}.

beam.name: BEAM Dashboard - Report Data
beam.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
beam.location: BEAM (Bacteria, Enterics, Amoeba, and Mycotics) Dashboard
beam.description: The BEAM Dashboard is an interactive tool built on the System for Enteric Disease Response, Investigation, and Coordination (SEDRIC) that provides timely data on enteric pathogen trends and serotype details to support prevention of illnesses from food, water, and animal contact. This source uses the state-level 'Report Data' export (dataset jbhn-e8xn) rather than the HHS-region export, so isolate counts can be represented with standard state FIPS codes. Raw records are aggregated across source type (human, food, animal, environment), source site, and serotype/species to produce a monthly isolate count per state and pathogen. National values are computed by PopHIVE/Ingest as the sum across all reporting states. Isolate rates per 100,000 population use a single 2021 Census population denominator for all years. Counts reflect isolates sequenced and reported by participating state and local public health laboratories, which varies by jurisdiction and pathogen, so trends should not be interpreted as complete disease incidence.
beam.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
